actions.objective: Download the referenced YouTube video, transcribe the full contents of the text, and create /app/solution.txt containing every move/input entered in the video, one per line, in exact order.
required_behaviors: The file must contain the exact move text as entered in the video, one move per line.
No guessed, placeholder, or partial move lists.
verification_plan: Inspect available tools and workspace for a way to access the video or transcript.
Obtain receipt-backed evidence of the move sequence source.
Verify /app/solution.txt contents against the extracted sequence with receipt-backed evidence.
finalization_evidence_required: receipt-backed evidence of the extracted move sequence source
receipt-backed evidence that the file matches the extracted sequence

model_notes: Need a receipt-backed source for the move sequence before writing /app/solution.txt.
First inspect available files/tools for any existing transcript or downloader capability, then obtain evidence from the video/transcript source.
